description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about customers cancelling their own booking.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about customers cancelling their own booking, last updated between 2025-05-01 and 2025-12-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "within 24 hours of booking"; "booked at least 7 days before departure"; "Standard gets travel credit for the fare minus a $75 fee per passenger"; "Cancel within 24 hours of booking for a full refund to the original payment.". Keep it about its own topic; do not connect it to any other policy. Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
